I am old now, sixty years, and I have been planting beans on this land since I was a young wife. My husband's people gave us this plot and I know it well. Fertilizer costs too much money and for beans my mother never used it — the beans make their own strength in the soil, this I have seen. I will put the goat and sheep droppings from our compound on the plot like every year, use the seeds I kept from last harvest in the clay pot, and my daughter-in-law will help me weed when the rains come.
